### Key Risks

- **Stomach and intestinal irritation or bleeding:** Both alcohol and ibuprofen (an NSAID) can irritate the stomach lining. Regular ibuprofen use or heavy drinking increases the chance of ulcers and gastrointestinal bleeding.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXW1kmS5Q444FhqrDjikUdSBbQVmnfTxDN9TyXElZDdc3Qd4q2oXQNBkfHSFfc9E5CUSjyZJmrol-8ky6mAlGzLsoJYNrXTzN6wCcDwZH9LijgNdMlKQvDVmF4iBUAXnB9QQVaR9Kstj_YzeKlgf-e)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXef8VlMepXuCGhd25hPVCPW1skJ5umAJGtQCMwj3_-sFP7gvWw9NVgls0LnMtrfXHJ04g84Gsijx3tPTGvt-0L4b2ynFvK1LfQESeaxq8JlqhCei7kh312vHFwSypVePn6NahpecfrUHF-zQfOdphvEaZjK-4)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESuAEBxCJF1_7gX9u6I_aseHhwYJ9e6Gdx6Ql3_uqafEIoyGY_bLMSZZkOV_P5PxvKx3Rr3AI9doMeUu1wcCg1wgpxoTmPQow0JfWKsr1gqPmufoucG2KCrYB0Bqbgj9Fx0uSbEBkOuEAKFWYbHLQXdK9pJkH-WF6ChnLqsZfsEwjlbJSQ7i25s1GGu8wGdN2bSEFHq0f38zJ7E5weRP_13D17HOBQGsP-89vHIXSqTJ1zuTpHw_1BY2of)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX5kGAj9ucZt-VmwMWKRjhgq4G1r1ybgORgDMAFUzMWU8zThaGDvslt39FCPHyI2ZB6y1mKGWG6hMpkbzpoxc2kCnWdgg0EFI8buEdV7ACQfDU9COemd3JjN3wABP4NPqjPv2KHPNW)
- **Kidney and liver strain:** Long-term use or heavy alcohol intake adds stress to your kidneys and can contribute to liver issues. A laboratory study published via [PubMed Central](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXlRpKj9prC_wKTP-TgurdqBa2e8SMguUYvF6p7pxLita8e0uFq1ppCkTqMA_ERPchP94ZSPcJ-yxPA0us_CooucMgeNdipBSkeLNtQ_pdecx1AR9YCOfnA6wvDSH5Gsu2tlX92VNgqg) also notes potential combined liver cell stress when alcohol and ibuprofen are paired.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXlRpKj9prC_wKTP-TgurdqBa2e8SMguUYvF6p7pxLita8e0uFq1ppCkTqMA_ERPchP94ZSPcJ-yxPA0us_CooucMgeNdipBSkeLNtQ_pdecx1AR9YCOfnA6wvDSH5Gsu2tlX92VNgqg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXef8VlMepXuCGhd25hPVCPW1skJ5umAJGtQCMwj3_-sFP7gvWw9NVgls0LnMtrfXHJ04g84Gsijx3tPTGvt-0L4b2ynFvK1LfQESeaxq8JlqhCei7kh312vHFwSypVePn6NahpecfrUHF-zQfOdphvEaZjK-4)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXW1kmS5Q444FhqrDjikUdSBbQVmnfTxDN9TyXElZDdc3Qd4q2oXQNBkfHSFfc9E5CUSjyZJmrol-8ky6mAlGzLsoJYNrXTzN6wCcDwZH9LijgNdMlKQvDVmF4iBUAXnB9QQVaR9Kstj_YzeKlgf-e)

### Practical Precautions

- **Timing:** As [GoodRx](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXW1kmS5Q444FhqrDjikUdSBbQVmnfTxDN9TyXElZDdc3Qd4q2oXQNBkfHSFfc9E5CUSjyZJmrol-8ky6mAlGzLsoJYNrXTzN6wCcDwZH9LijgNdMlKQvDVmF4iBUAXnB9QQVaR9Kstj_YzeKlgf-e) notes, ibuprofen typically takes around 10 hours for an average body to clear (and potentially up to 17 hours if you have liver issues), making waiting at least 10 hours after a dose a sensible buffer before drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXW1kmS5Q444FhqrDjikUdSBbQVmnfTxDN9TyXElZDdc3Qd4q2oXQNBkfHSFfc9E5CUSjyZJmrol-8ky6mAlGzLsoJYNrXTzN6wCcDwZH9LijgNdMlKQvDVmF4iBUAXnB9QQVaR9Kstj_YzeKlgf-e)

- **When to seek care:** Get prompt medical help if you notice severe or persistent stomach pain, black or tarry stools, vomiting blood or material that looks like coffee grounds, fainting, or swelling in your hands, feet, or ankles. For more details on symptoms and everyday use, see [Healthline](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXef8VlMepXuCGhd25hPVCPW1skJ5umAJGtQCMwj3_-sFP7gvWw9NVgls0LnMtrfXHJ04g84Gsijx3tPTGvt-0L4b2ynFvK1LfQESeaxq8JlqhCei7kh312vHFwSypVePn6NahpecfrUHF-zQfOdphvEaZjK-4).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXef8VlMepXuCGhd25hPVCPW1skJ5umAJGtQCMwj3_-sFP7gvWw9NVgls0LnMtrfXHJ04g84Gsijx3tPTGvt-0L4b2ynFvK1LfQESeaxq8JlqhCei7kh312vHFwSypVePn6NahpecfrUHF-zQfOdphvEaZjK-4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXnrckr9vRdyw7HP-hpcF7vjGPwu8unCQU8iFiA4r1BjBqb-rFBlXQy5KjLnDT-Om6dYIUDaloii8xZIebgxldUDWgIRjaloURVIhtdgDrtUw-U-xPfA_EF0byDsTfoz8iGHySlCZFixBeWvBA1j680IuyjgeOTg)
